### Setup

### Result

- Expected and observed behavior (or what worked):
- Event time and timezone:
- Nearby deliberate updates, restarts, power/network changes:

### Diagnostics, if available

- Uptime and Reset Reason:
- Maximum Loop Time, Free Heap and Largest Free Heap Block:
- Door State / Door State Valid, Control Phase / Last Action Reason:
- Sanitized screenshot or log excerpt:

<!-- No extra door cycles are required to report. A loop maximum is not an exact
crash timestamp. Stop using the affected setup if movement is unexpected or native
controls are interfered with; never bypass manufacturer safety devices. -->
